segments.tts: Agenty. Top agent. Best eye in hockey. You're welcome.
My top five prospects of all time. Number five: Eric Lindros. Drafted first, 1991 – and refused to sign with Quebec!
The Flyers paid six players, two first-rounders and fifteen million dollars.
Number four: Connor McDavid. Allowed into junior hockey a year early – at fifteen.
Number three: Sidney Crosby. The 2005 draft lottery was called the Sidney Crosby Sweepstakes!
Number two: Mario Lemieux. One hundred thirty-three goals in one junior season!
Back in my day, that was a career.
Number one: Wayne Gretzky. Three hundred seventy-eight goals… at age ten.
At ten I couldn't tie my skates.
Pucky, kid – you've got star power. Sign here.
